tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Window background behind the sidebar and the content area. Never put body text straight on it; text sits on surface or raised.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The content area: recording list, transcript column, summaries. Default ground for ink and ink-muted.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Things that sit on the surface: voice cards, summary cards, menus, dialogs, the player bar.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the scrubber track, the empty part of meters, the drop zone, input fills in dense rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only; it carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of controls that must be found: text fields, the number-of-people field, secondary buttons. At least 3:1 on surface and raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, raised and sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on surface and raised: dates, durations, captions, timecodes, helper lines.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholders only. Below 4.5:1 on purpose: never use it for text the user must read.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue (nastro amber, softened). FILLS only: the primary button, the play button, the played part of the scrubber, the running pulse. Not for text or thin icons on surface/raised: use accent-ink.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill (primary buttons, the play button). Dark in both themes: the soft amber is too light for white text.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Accent fill on hover and press. Lighter than accent in both themes, so on-accent stays readable on it.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet accent ground: the segment that is playing, selected rows, the running status chip. Ink stays readable on it.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text and as icons/marks on surface, raised and accent-soft: links (Annulla, Salta), the done check, the pin, the active nav icon, the playhead ring, the selected-segment outline.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus ring, offset 2px. Solid, 3:1 or more on every surface.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Crimson, kept away from the amber accent. Failure text and icons: a failed transcription, destructive confirmations (Elimina). Always paired with a word and the alert icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of error banners and the failed status chip; danger or ink text on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Steel blue, kept away from the amber accent so a limitation never reads as the brand. Text and icon for states that limit the user without failing: read-only while re-transcribing, audio file missing, provisional results.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of warning banners; warning or ink text on it.

tokens.name: voice-1
tokens.usage: Voice 1 (and the person it is named as). Dots, the speaking-share bar, lane marks on the scrubber. Never text colour; the name next to it is ink.

tokens.name: voice-2
tokens.usage: Voice 2 (olive). Same rules as voice-1. Chosen 57° of hue away from the amber accent so its lanes never read as the playhead.

tokens.name: voice-3
tokens.usage: Voice 3. Same rules as voice-1.

tokens.name: voice-4
tokens.usage: Voice 4. Same rules as voice-1.

tokens.name: voice-5
tokens.usage: Voice 5. Same rules as voice-1.

tokens.name: voice-6
tokens.usage: Voice 6. Same rules as voice-1.

tokens.name: voice-7
tokens.usage: Voice 7. Same rules as voice-1.

tokens.name: voice-8
tokens.usage: Voice 8, and any voice past 8 (the palette repeats from voice-1 after it). Same rules as voice-1.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen title: the project name on its home, the recording title on its page. One per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Section and card titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Row titles in lists, voice names on cards, names in the transcript.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default interface text: messages, descriptions, menu items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata under a title, helper and error lines under fields.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Small uppercase group labels in the sidebar and inside summaries. Uppercase via CSS, never typed in caps.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The few numbers a summary leads with (total hours, recordings, people). Tabular figures.

styles.name: transcript
styles.sample: Buongiorno a tutti, iniziamo con il punto sull'ordine del giorno di oggi.
styles.usage: What people said: transcript segments. Measure 68ch at most.

styles.name: abstract
styles.sample: Si è discusso il bilancio; Marco manda la bozza entro venerdì.
styles.usage: Summary prose (riassunto) of a recording or a project.

styles.name: timecode
styles.usage: Timecodes and durations next to segments, in the player and in rows. Tabular, never in the reading face.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its label, dot to its name.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related controls; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inside rows and toolbars; between a title and its metadata.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between transcript segments.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Content padding of a screen; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Around empty states.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, chips, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards, the player bar, banners, the drop zone.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs and popovers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips, the play button, dots and meters.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, dialogs and the drag preview only. Cards use a hairline, not a shadow.

tokens.name: icon-s
tokens.usage: Icons inside chips, rows and small buttons.

tokens.name: icon-m
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, the toolbar and the sidebar.

tokens.name: control-s
tokens.usage: Height of compact buttons and fields inside rows and cards.

tokens.name: control-m
tokens.usage: Height of standard buttons and fields.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Width of the left navigation.

tokens.name: panel-width
tokens.usage: Width of the right-hand panel on a recording (Voci, Riassunto).

tokens.name: reading-measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length of transcript and summary text.
